# Apt packages for the Tidy SYCL (clang-tidy-sycl) job in lint-and-format.yml.
# One package per line; comments starting with # are ignored.

# Minimal oneAPI install — only the DPC++/C++ compiler component for sycl/sycl.hpp.
intel-oneapi-compiler-dpcpp-cpp

# libze-dev is the Level Zero loader development package.
# core/src/meson.build calls cc.find_library('ze_loader'), which emits
# a literal -lze_loader; ld resolves that against the unversioned
# libze_loader.so symlink ONLY. Package name is release-specific:
# libze-dev on 24.04 noble (universe); level-zero-dev does not exist there.
libze-dev

ninja-build
nasm
jq
parallel

# clang-tidy-22 from apt.llvm.org: the ubuntu-24.04 image tops out at clang 18.
clang-tidy-22
